name: browser-use
headline: ai co-writing with claude skills system
short_description: AI Co-Writing System with Claude Skills enables content creators to generate and refine text using Claude's AI capabilities. It benefits operations teams by streamlining content creation workflows. The system connects to editors like Cursor and follows context engineering principles for efficient writing.
author: az9713

sections.overview:
The AI Co-Writing System is a complete Claude Code writing platform built on context engineering principles. It uses packaged Claude Skills to generate content across multiple formats—LinkedIn posts, Twitter threads, Substack notes, thought leadership pieces, and more. The system works by reading your context profiles (voice DNA, ideal client profile, and business profile) to create content that matches your unique voice and brand. Setup involves creating three foundational profiles, then requesting content through natural language prompts. It integrates with editors like Cursor and includes a knowledge base for storing drafts, notes, and published content.
Generate LinkedIn posts and profile optimizations in your brand voice
Create Twitter threads and Substack notes from your writing samples
Build sales email sequences using your business context
Produce thought leadership and how-to guide content
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/az9713/ai-co-writing-claude-skills`
sections.usage:
```
Help me draft a blog post about [TOPIC] for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. I want to focus on [KEY POINTS] and use a [TONE] style. Please provide an outline first, and then we can refine each section together.
```
Copy

```
# Blog Post Outline: The Future of Sustainable Packaging in the Food Industry
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
